strengths: Every round-7 critical is fixed. The chapter index tab now drops in from the top left. The finale's fast-forward runs five wordless flashes at exactly the pitch of the prologue's rewind (0.75 s, ff1 at 1.0 to ff5 at 4.0). ch01-s03 makes its three-move climb in an unhurried 2.2 s lead-in. ch01-s05 ends on a true full wide. Crowded stamps are gone (ch05-s03 keeps one stamp at a time; ch12-s08's windows are 1 s apart).

The deep dives teach with real, bound mechanisms rather than boxes. ch08-s04's tin stencil works a real Sobel sum to 3.88 and then slides it into a feature map. ch08-s05 builds AlexNet as a cathedral with true layer widths, wordless max-pool windows and rose-window vignettes. ch10-s06 pours a jug of light into cups at the real softmax shares (0.20 · 0.07 · 0.53 · 0.20). ch10-s07 freezes the cups when the scores are unscaled. ch10-s14 drops a curtain and the forward threads snap.

The recurring devices form a coherent visual grammar: candle-clock sleeves as a bar chart in wax, the case board that becomes a lantern network in ch15-s08, the X-ray column lighting one band per era, the Wall of Forecasts, and the oxblood question thread. With the STUDY LOCK and STUDY CAMERAS rules, the film always knows where it is.

The geopolitics chapter is a strong, fair staging idea. The strait is seen through the study window, both shores are mirror-balanced at equal warmth, the candles appear only as a reflection, and a Go board on the jetty carries move and answer. Even-handedness is built into the composition, not left to the narration.

Callbacks are made in pictures: the LED match-cut from bedroom GPU to pixel grid, the tin toy stencil sliding beside a learned edge tile in ch08-s09, the desk lamp clicking on at the edge of the new candle's pool in ch08-s13b, and the ch12-s06 return to the cold-open room with the chat box swinging open like a door.
